speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am through. Dinner when you cut. I will not make you send it looking.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: See that you do not. The cloth stays in my arms, which is the goodbye you are getting.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is the right goodbye. Paper this morning. The yard after. I can tell them apart in the street, where you will not have to hear me do it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then do it in the street. And come back hungry, not interesting.
